title: Machine Configuration
statement: Given a label $l\in Lb(K_0)$, a state $st$, a memory function $M:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and a memory pointer $p\in\mathbb Z$, the abbreviation denotes the machine configuration whose active instruction is $l$, whose register values are those encoded by $st$, whose answer is unset, and whose memory consists of $M$ with pointer $p$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean-valued memory function on the integers
